title: agent_bench keys an error result on is_error only, so an error_max_turns result with is_error false is a finished area
goal: agent_bench.result_of treats a result whose subtype starts with error_ as an error whatever is_error says, so bench_repro.failure_of names it turns or budget. Found by the SP-ygsnog4n review (S3).

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import json,agent_bench,bench_repro as b;r=agent_bench.result_of(json.dumps({'type':'result','subtype':'error_max_turns','is_error':False,'num_turns':150,'duration_api_ms':1,'total_cost_usd':3.2,'usage':{'input_tokens':1,'cache_creation_input_tokens':2,'cache_read_input_tokens':3,'output_tokens':4}}),'',5.0);sys.exit(0 if b.failure_of(r) else 1)
